description: The agent must: (1) Locate and use the living-room-air-monitor skill's scripts at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/living-room-air-monitor/scripts/. (2) Import get_all_averages_by_month from scripts/query_data.py and call it with '2025-03' to retrieve the four monthly averages from the SQLite DB at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/living-room-air-monitor/data/air_quality.db. (3) Apply the PROPRIETARY threshold logic to compute assessments: PM2.5 uses 'Unhealthy' (not 'Poor') for >35 µg/m³, and CO2 uses 'Poor' (not 'Unhealthy') for >2000 ppm — agents relying on generic training will swap these labels. (4) Import generate_text_report from scripts/send_report.py and call it with start_dt='2025-03-10 00:00:00' and end_dt='2025-03-16 23:59:59' (7-day window ending March 16) to generate the weekly text report. (5) Save the weekly report to week_ending_20250316_report.txt. (6) Count the characters in the weekly report and include that count in march_2025_air_audit.json along with all averages, assessments, and the report file path.
